payload.name: Extract explicit dated family events from nostalgic messages
payload.description: When a user shares a personal or family event with a specific year/date in a nostalgic or emotional message, generate an event memory candidate during extraction.
content: During candidate extraction, if a message contains an explicit statement about a personal or family event with a time reference (e.g., 'my parents' wedding in 1993'), create an event memory candidate even when the message is framed as a memory, photo caption, or emotional reflection.
Use the appropriate memory kind (event) and include the relationship and date as stated. Do not discard facts because the tone is nostalgic or the evidence is a photo.

solves: This solves missed event extraction when explicit dated facts are embedded in nostalgic or photo-caption messages. The diagnosis showed a message stating 'my parents' wedding in 1993' produced no candidates. The rule abstracts the mechanism: construction agents may under-extract explicit facts in reflective context. It applies to any future message where a user mentions a dated personal/family event in a reminiscing tone.
